skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and use basic English in the field of Information Technology, including specialized vocabulary and grammar structures.
Ability to search for, collect, synthesize, analyze, and present information in English related to IT.
Communicate technical issues in English with foreign speakers and translate technical documents.
Develop independent writing skills and the ability to form and communicate in groups on professional topics.
Work effectively in groups and present findings in English.
Understand social context and professional ethics in the IT field.
Ability to independently learn and understand materials to complete assignments.
Maintain discipline in class and adhere to class rules.
Organize and communicate effectively within a group.
Analyze and solve problems using critical thinking skills.
Understand and use IT terminology in English.
Understand and explain computer hardware components.
Understand and explain computer software, including operating systems and applications.
Understand and explain networking and the Internet.
Understand IT career paths and roles.
